programs.nl_rule:
In the input, you should see a square and some colored rectangles stacked and attached to some of the edges of the grid.
The output grid size stays the same.
To make the output, you have to attach a diagonal red segment at each corner of the square that does not touch an edge of the grid. Each attachment must extend till it either hits the partial border made by the stack of rectangles or it hits an edge of the grid. You should end with the same original design as the input, but with these added red extensions/attachments to the square in the input.
